archetype: 2 (The Performance Pro / Precision Financial Command Center)
context: GestorCred SaaS - Consultas Feature (Brazilian Credit & Data Lookup)

shell_layout.page_container: p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto space-y-6

header.title: Consultas Cadastrais & Score
header.subtitle: Dossiê completo para análise de risco e concessão de crédito

module_tabs.active_tab_style: bg-primary text-primary-foreground font-semibold shadow-sm shadow-primary/20 border-primary
module_tabs.badge_coming_soon: text-[10px] font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-muted text-muted-foreground

search_and_quota_bar.container: rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card p-5 shadow-sm space-y-4
search_and_quota_bar.input: w-full pl-11 pr-4 py-3 rounded-xl bg-background border border-border text-foreground font-mono placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/40 focus:border-primary transition-all
search_and_quota_bar.button: px-6 py-3 rounded-xl bg-primary text-primary-foreground font-semibold hover:opacity-90 active:scale-[0.99] transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-lg shadow-primary/20 disabled:opacity-50
search_and_quota_bar.quota_progress_bar: h-2 w-full bg-muted rounded-full overflow-hidden mt-2

history_sidebar.container: rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card p-4 space-y-3
history_sidebar.item_card: w-full text-left rounded-xl border border-border/80 bg-background/50 hover:bg-sidebar-accent p-3.5 transition-all group relative cursor-pointer hover:border-primary/30 hover:shadow-sm

hero_profile_summary.container: rounded-3xl border border-primary/20 bg-gradient-to-br from-card via-card to-primary/5 p-6 sm:p-8 relative overflow-hidden shadow-xl
hero_profile_summary.background_glow: absolute -top-24 -right-24 w-72 h-72 bg-primary/10 rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none

identity_header.avatar_box: w-16 h-16 sm:w-20 sm:h-20 rounded-2xl bg-primary/15 border border-primary/30 flex items-center justify-center text-primary shadow-inner flex-shrink-0
identity_header.name_typography: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-display font-bold text-foreground tracking-tight
identity_header.cpf_badge: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-md bg-muted/80 font-mono text-xs font-semibold text-foreground border border-border/60
identity_header.status_badge_active: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-md bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-500 border border-emerald-500/20 text-xs font-semibold

score_gauge_visual.concept: Segmented 10-bar credit risk meter or circular/semi-circular gauge using HSL tokens

hero_profile_summary.quick_stats_grid: grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3 mt-6 pt-6 border-t border-border/60

quick_stat_item.label: text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground font-semibold
quick_stat_item.value: text-sm font-semibold text-foreground mt-0.5 truncate font-mono

hero_profile_summary.scannable_chips_bar: flex flex-wrap gap-2 mt-4 pt-4 border-t border-border/40
hero_profile_summary.section_chip: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-lg bg-card border border-border text-xs font-medium text-foreground hover:border-primary/40 transition-colors

results_organization.grouping_strategy: Categorized Tabbed Navigation or Sectioned 2-Column Responsive Layout

info_card.container: rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card overflow-hidden transition-all duration-200 hover:border-border/80 shadow-sm
info_card.header: flex items-center justify-between px-5 py-4 bg-muted/20 border-b border-border/60 cursor-pointer select-none
info_card.title_group: flex items-center gap-3 font-display font-semibold text-sm sm:text-base text-foreground
info_card.icon_box: w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-primary/10 text-primary flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0
info_card.count_badge: text-xs px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-primary/15 text-primary font-mono font-medium
info_card.empty_state_badge: text-xs px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-muted text-muted-foreground font-mono

key_value_grid.grid_classes: grid gap-x-6 gap-y-3 sm:grid-cols-2 p-5 bg-card
key_value_grid.label: text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground font-semibold font-mono
key_value_grid.enum_badge: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-md text-xs font-medium font-mono

general_ui_ux_guidelines.testing_attributes: All interactive buttons, input elements, tabs, accordions, and key informational chips MUST include a kebab-case role-based data-testid (e.g. data-testid='consulta-cpf-input', data-testid='consulta-score-badge', data-testid='consulta-secao-enderecos').
general_ui_ux_guidelines.theme_compatibility: Must strictly use CSS variable utility classes (bg-background, bg-card, border-border, text-foreground, text-muted-foreground, text-primary, bg-primary/10) to support both dark and light modes cleanly without color hardcoding.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.dropdown_overlays: Never use fully transparent backgrounds on dropdowns or floating menus; always use bg-popover or bg-card with backdrop-blur-md and z-50.
